FULL TEXT:
NOTIFICATION
Date: 17.03.2025
The university vide its Advertisement No. HBTU/Estt/02/2024 dated 07.12.2024
had invited online Applications in prescribed format for the post of “Medical Officer” in
the university. The applications received for the post of Medical Officer were scrutinized
by a duly constituted screening/scrutiny committee and scores awarded as per the
“Assessment Methodology for calculation of API/Research Score for the post of Medical
Officer” presented in Table B of the “Screening and Selection Criteria” uploaded on the
website along with the Advertisement. Based on the recommendations of the
Screening/scrutiny committee, the “lists of candidates found eligible/provisionally
eligible/not eligible along with their API score” were displayed on this university
website www.hbtu.ac.in (under the recruitment link) on 03/03/2025.
The grievances/objections on the eligibility, score awarded, if any were also
invited from the candidates at the Email Id: recruitment2024@hbtu.ac.in from their
registered email Id given in the Application Form, latest by 10.03.2025 (Monday, 07 PM).
All grievances received up to 10/03/2025 were again considered by the screening
committee. Consequently, the final/freezed eligibility/API scores of the candidates are being
displayed with this notification under the recruitment link.
It would be pertinent to mention that all those candidates who are provisionally
eligible shall be subject to verification of documents in original (especially related to
educational qualifications, caste certificate, experience, research papers etc.) at the time of
interview, if called for. Those in employment should submit the “No Objection Certificate”
from their present employer at the time of Interview.
Note:
1. The University shall not be responsible for any error/omission/relevant Information by
the applicant knowingly or unknowingly while filling up the application form. In case
the applicant gets Screened/shortlisted/selected/appointed on the basis of the Incorrect
forged/fabricated Credentials furnished by him/her, his/her candidature shall be liable
to be cancelled at any stage of the recruitment/at any time during the tenure of the
service and appropriate legal action under applicable law shall be initiated against the
applicant.
2. The University reserves the right for alteration/modification/correction in the event of
any error.
Registrar
IMPORTANT: All eligible/ provisionally eligible candidates for the post of Medical Officer are hereby
informed that,
(a) The written test for the post is scheduled on 30/03/2025 at 12:00– 02:00 PM.
(b) The candidates will be able to download the admit cards for the written test from 24/03/2025 onwards
using the login Id and password/Form No.
(c) The candidates will be required to use the six-digit Roll no. as mentioned in this list on the OMR sheet
(On the day of written test).
